text: The 2019 Audited Consolidated Financial Statements and Report have been prepared by Welch LLP and are presented to the Board of Directors of Toronto Atmospheric Fund for approval. These statements provide separate fund accounting for both the City of Toronto and the Province of Ontario endowment funds.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved transfers of $3,004,823 to the Toronto Stabilization Fund and $1,814,782 to the Ontario Stabilization Fund. 2. Approved the 2019 Audited Consolidated Financial Statements.
